experiment.note: Single paired clean build, not a repeated-run statistical estimate. Same dependency snapshot, tools, compiler audit wrappers and job limit in both variants. Other system workloads are not stopped.

common_machine_compatibility.reason: GCC 11 SVE compile probe failed; both variants skip optional SVE kernels

experiment.torch_npu_generator: Unset global CMAKE_GENERATOR; top-level setup auto-detects Ninja, nested TorchAir helper uses Makefiles.
experiment.source_layout: PyTorch editable build is measured, then sources and native install artifacts are copied into case venv for torch-npu outside the measured interval.
experiment.linker: Both groups use GCC 11.4 + LLD 22.1.8, retaining Cortex-A53 erratum protection. PyTorch uses native LLD layout and upstream symbol ordering, 8 linker threads. Official LLD packages are extracted under the experiment root; system toolchains are unchanged.
experiment.dvm_warning_policy: Both torch-npu builds retain DVM diagnostics but use -Wno-error=mismatched-new-delete. This changes warning treatment, not code generation. Only DVM compile calls receive this compatibility flag.

cache_audit.method: separate copies of unbuilt source trees; separate build directories; compiler caches disabled; no shared-system page-cache flush

limitations: One paired clean build per variant, baseline then instrumented. No repeat-based confidence interval.
No OS page-cache flush or reboot; filesystem cache, order effects and other server workloads are not eliminated.
PyTorch total measures pip editable build/install. torch-npu total measures ci/build.sh build and wheel packaging, excluding subsequent wheel installation.
Ninja per-target durations overlap under parallelism and cannot be added to reconstruct wall time.
wait4 max_rss_kib is a process high-water mark, not the simultaneous aggregate memory of all compiler jobs.

PyTorch measurements were retained after passing validation; both torch-npu stages were independently rebuilt from pristine source copies after the DVM warning failure. The total is the sum of component build times, not one uninterrupted wall-clock run.
excluded_attempts: Missing system time command before compilation; measurement changed to Python monotonic clock and wait4.
Initial PyTorch configure failed SVE probe.
torch-npu precompile tools import conflict from editable PyTorch.
Initial torch-npu partial build failed nested TorchAir generator mismatch; source directory archived and fresh source copied before successful run.

Initial r7 torch-npu instrumentation failed in DVM due to -Werror=mismatched-new-delete. Both prior NPU stages were archived and rebuilt cleanly with the same DVM-only warning policy; no NPU object files were reused.
r3 BFD instrumented run used for diagnosis and interrupted; excluded from final timing.
r4 LLD configure attempted NCCL download; aborted, dependency source prepared before r5.

r5 LLD 15 native layout was slow; r6 generated-script linking was fast but baseline import failed with SIGSEGV. Both configurations are excluded. Only r7 isolated LLD 22 native layout is used for the final comparison.

linker_diagnosis.causal_interpretation: Instrumentation greatly increases section/code/relocation/string-table volume. Sampling shows BFD section-pattern scanning, and later repeated full stub-table traversal for each section in elf64_aarch64_write_section -> bfd_hash_traverse -> _bfd_aarch64_erratum_843419_branch_to_stub. Same object inputs link successfully with LLD in 36.9s. Removing just selected BFD options is not established as a complete remedy. IMPORTANT: Successful LLD linking in 36.9 seconds did not establish runtime compatibility. The generated-script configuration failed runtime validation and is rejected.
measurement_corrections: Original r3 instrumented build overlapped diagnostics and is excluded from final clean timing.
r4 LLD attempt encountered NCCL source fetching inside configure; aborted and excluded. NCCL v2.32.3-1 source-only checkout was prepared outside timing for r5.
No ccache/sccache, fresh build dirs; OS page cache not flushed, so not a strict cold-cache experiment.

r5 native LLD 15 was excluded after slow linking. Generated-script links finished in about 36 seconds, but r6 baseline subsequently failed import with SIGSEGV and is rejected. Native LLD 15 without ordering also exceeded 180 seconds, so the ordering file alone is not established as the cause. A newer official isolated LLD is under validation.
linker_diagnosis.decision: User explicitly approved unified LLD for both groups, conditional on trace_api_chain full capture/replay/source-location/SQL/HTML validation on new PyTorch and torch-npu.

plugin_debuglink_fix.cause: Missing Dwfl_Callbacks.find_debuginfo callback causes SIGSEGV for ELF binaries containing .gnu_debuglink.
plugin_debuglink_fix.reproduction: Two small shared-library tests both failed before the fix: split debug file present and missing.
plugin_debuglink_fix.fix: Set dwfl_standard_find_debuginfo; preserve unresolved symbols as unmapped when debug file is absent.
